response: ## Perspective Audit Findings ### Cognitive & Neurodivergent (HIGH) **Finding:** Technical jargon and unexplained acronyms (HSTS, CSP, SRI, CORS, Brotli, stale-while-revalidate, WAL, Prometheus) are used as primary labels without glossary links, tooltips, or plain-English alternatives. **WCAG:** 3.1.4 Abbreviations / 3.1.5 Reading Level **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Content Author (primary) + UX Design (secondary) **Evidence:** `SECURITY_TOGGLES`, `PERFORMANCE_TOGGLES`, and `LOGGING_TOGGLES` arrays contain unexplained acronyms and complex technical terms. No supporting documentation or inline definitions exist in the markup. **Fix:** Add a glossary link or tooltip for each acronym; provide plain-English descriptions alongside technical labels (e.g., "Enable HSTS preloading (HTTP Strict Transport Security)"). Simplify sentence structure to ≤14th-grade reading level where possible. ### Magnification & Reflow (HIGH) **Finding:** Three-column grid layout lacks responsive breakpoints, causing horizontal overflow or severely cramped content at narrow viewports (e.g., 320px). **WCAG:** 1.4.10 Reflow **Perspective:** Magnification & Reflow **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Visual Design (primary) + Front-End Dev (secondary) **Evidence:** `.settings-grid` CSS defines `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;` with no media queries for small viewports. No horizontal scroll suppression or reflow logic is present. **Fix:** Add `@media (max-width: 768px)` to collapse the grid to a single column, stack content vertically, and ensure zero horizontal scrolling at 320px equivalent viewport width. ### Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (MEDIUM) **Finding:** Inline error messages are visually placed but not programmatically associated with their respective form inputs via `aria-describedby`. The `role="alert"` pattern is also misapplied for inline validation feedback. **WCAG:** 3.3.1 Error Identification **Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) + Content Author (secondary) **Evidence:** `{t.error && {t.error}}` lacks `aria-describedby` reference on the input. Error text is a technical code (`ERR_CSP_001`) rather than descriptive guidance. **Fix:** Add `aria-describedby={errorId}` to each checkbox. Replace `role="alert"` with `aria-live="polite"` or use standard form validation attributes (`aria-invalid="true"`, `aria-errormessage`). Update error text to plain English with remediation steps. ### Environmental Contrast (MEDIUM) **Finding 1:** Section headers (`color: #666`) fail minimum contrast ratio for normal text (requires ≥4.5:1; #666 on #fff achieves ~4.05:1). **WCAG:** 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) **Perspective:** Environmental Contrast **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Visual Design (primary) + Front-End Dev (secondary) **Evidence:** `.settings-column h2` CSS sets `color: #666;` on a white background. Measured ratio falls below AA threshold for non-large text. **Fix:** Change header color to at least `#595959` or darker to achieve ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio against the background. **Finding 2:** Required field indicator relies solely on a colored asterisk without accompanying text, violating non-color dependency rules. **WCAG:** 1.4.1 Use of Color / 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics **Perspective:** Environmental Contrast **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Visual Design (primary) + Front-End Dev (secondary) **Evidence:** `*` used for required fields. Color and shape are the only indicators. **Fix:** Replace asterisk with text indicator "(Required)" or add a screen-reader-only label `aria-label="Required"`. Ensure visual indicator is not color-dependent and remains visible in forced-colors/high-contrast modes. --- ## Perspective Audit Summary **Component/artifact reviewed:** Dense Admin Settings Panel With Jargon **Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent (HIGH), Magnification & Reflow (HIGH), Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (MEDIUM), Environmental Contrast (MEDIUM) **Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access, Keyboard & Motor Access ### Findings by Severity | Severity | Count | |---|---| | CRITICAL | 0 | | MAJOR | 6 | | MINOR | 0 | | ENHANCEMENT | 0 | ### Perspectives That Passed None. All escalated perspectives contain at least one MAJOR finding requiring revision. ### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role **Front-End Dev** - Inline errors not programmatically associated with inputs — Screen Reader Semantic — MAJOR — 3.3.1 Error Identification - Three-column grid lacks reflow breakpoints — Magnification & Reflow — MAJOR — 1.4.10 Reflow - Required indicator relies on color/shape only — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.1 / 1.3.3 **Visual Design** - Section headers fail normal text contrast ratio — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) - Three-column grid lacks reflow breakpoints — Magnification & Reflow — MAJOR — 1.4.10 Reflow - Required indicator relies on color/shape only — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.1 / 1.3.3 **UX Design** - Technical jargon used without glossary/tooltips — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.1.4 / 3.1.5 - Technical jargon used without glossary/tooltips — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.1.4 / 3.1.5 **Content Author** - Error messages use technical codes instead of plain English — Screen Reader Semantic — MAJOR — 3.3.1 Error Identification - Technical jargon used without glossary/tooltips — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.1.4 / 3.1.5 ### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification - [Human verification required] Verify that `ERR_CSP_001` and other error codes are replaced with plain-English guidance before shipping. - [Human verification required] Confirm reading level of toggle labels meets ≤14th-grade standard for non-technical admin users. - [Human verification required] Validate forced-colors/high-contrast mode behavior across all interactive states (focus, hover, disabled). ### Recommended Next Step **REVISE** — MAJOR findings are present across all escalated perspectives. Address contrast ratios, reflow breakpoints, error association, and jargon definitions before shipping. No CRITICAL blockers exist, but the component will fail WCAG 2.2 AA compliance in its current state.
